shell_main_empty_description: No view is available yet. The settings are in the sidebar.
shell_view_missing_description: No feature provides the view {view}. Choose a view in the sidebar.
shell_part_unknown: This version of Mannie cannot show content of type {kind}.
shell_command_palette_description: Type to find a command, then press Enter to run it.
shell_settings_missing_title: This settings page is not available
shell_settings_missing_description: No feature provides the settings page {section}. Choose a page in the sidebar.
shell_settings_interface_description: The language and the colors of Mannie's window.
shell_settings_language_description: Changing the language reloads the window. Replies that are being written continue.
shell_settings_load_failed_title: The interface settings could not be read
shell_error_invalid_locale: Mannie does not recognize the language {tag}. Choose a language from the list.
shell_error_written_by_newer_version: A newer version of Mannie saved these settings, so this version cannot change them. Install the newer version to change them.
shell_error_storage_failed: The settings could not be read or saved. The log in Mannie's data folder has the cause. Try again, and restart Mannie if it keeps failing.
shell_error_store_unavailable: The database is not open, so the settings cannot be read or saved.
shell_error_ipc_failed: Mannie's window could not reach its core. Restart Mannie.
shell_startup_database_too_new: A newer version of Mannie wrote the database at {path}. It has schema version {databaseVersion}, and this version of Mannie supports up to version {supportedVersion}. The database was left untouched. Install the newer version of Mannie to open it.
shell_startup_migration_failed: Mannie could not update the database at {path} to schema version {version}. The update was undone, and a copy of the database from before it is in {backupDirectory}. Restart Mannie to try again, and report the problem with the log file if it fails again.
shell_startup_database_unavailable: Mannie could not open its database at {path}. Check that the disk has free space and that your account can read and write the file, then restart Mannie.
shell_startup_data_directory_unavailable: Mannie could not find the folder for its data. Check that your user profile is available, then restart Mannie.
shell_startup_http_client_unavailable: Mannie could not set up its connections to model providers, for example because the system's certificates could not be read. Restart Mannie, and report the problem with the log file if it happens again.
markdown_copy_failed: Copying failed. Select the code and copy it yourself.
markdown_link_description: The link comes from a reply and opens in your browser. Check where it leads before you open it.
markdown_link_invalid: This link cannot be opened because it is not a complete web address.
markdown_link_unsupported_scheme: Links of the type {scheme} do not open from Mannie. Only web addresses that start with http or https open in the browser.
markdown_link_too_long: This link is longer than {maxBytes} bytes, so Mannie does not open it.
markdown_link_open_failed: The browser could not be opened. Check that your system has a default browser, then try again.
chat_compacting: Summarizing older messages for the model…
chat_new_description: Write a message below. Mannie sends it to the default provider profile and shows the reply as it arrives.
chat_no_profile_description: Replies need a provider profile with a server and a model. Add one in the provider settings.
chat_conversation_gone_description: It was deleted. Start a new conversation or choose another one in the sidebar.
chat_conversation_failed_title: The conversation could not be opened
chat_conversation_ended: Mannie is quitting. The conversation stops updating.
chat_checkpoint_marker: Messages above this line are summarized for the model.
chat_checkpoint_description_loading: The model reads this summary instead of the messages it covers.

match.turnsPlural=one: The model reads this summary instead of the first message and its reply. It brought the context from {before: number} to about {after: number} tokens.
match.turnsPlural=other: The model reads this summary instead of the first {turns: number} messages and their replies. It brought the context from {before: number} to about {after: number} tokens.

chat_composer_hint: Enter sends, Shift+Enter starts a new line, and Escape stops the reply.
chat_profile_menu_label: Provider profile for the next replies
chat_context_unknown_details: Mannie measures the context with the first reply.
chat_context_estimated: This is an estimate. The provider's token counts replace it after the next reply.
chat_reasoning_hidden: The model reasoned before it answered.
chat_status_compacting: Summarizing older messages for the model…
chat_status_output_limit: The reply stopped at the profile's output limit.
chat_status_content_filter: The provider's content filter ended the reply.
chat_status_prompt_cut: The server may have left out the start of this conversation: it reported a shorter request than Mannie sent. Set the model's context size on the server to the profile's context window, or lower the profile's context window.
chat_status_interrupted: Mannie quit before this reply finished.
chat_rename_description: The new title shows in the sidebar and in the window's title.
chat_delete_description: "{title}" and all its messages are deleted. A reply that is being written stops. This cannot be undone.
chat_failure_invalid_credential: The provider refused the API key. Check the profile's API key in the provider settings.
chat_failure_permission_denied: The API key has no permission for this model or request. Check the account's access at the provider.
chat_failure_quota_exceeded: The account's quota at the provider is used up. Check the account's plan or billing.
chat_failure_model_not_found: The server does not know the model {model}. Check the model name in the provider settings.
chat_failure_endpoint_not_found: The server has no such endpoint. Check the base URL and the API interface in the provider settings.
chat_failure_rate_limited: The provider limits the request rate. Try again later.
chat_failure_rate_limited_until: The provider limits the request rate. Try again after {time}.
chat_failure_server_error: The server failed with status {status}. Try again later.
chat_failure_context_overflow: The conversation is longer than the model's context, even after summarizing. Start a new conversation or use a model with a larger context window.
chat_failure_request_too_large: The latest message alone does not fit into the model's context. Shorten it, or use a model with a larger context window.
chat_failure_bad_request: The server refused the request with status {status}. Check the profile's model, limits and reasoning effort.
chat_failure_content_filtered: The provider's content filter refused the request or the reply.
chat_failure_connection_failed: The server could not be reached. Check the base URL and the network connection.
chat_failure_timed_out: The server did not answer in time.
chat_failure_broken_stream: The reply stopped before it was complete.
chat_failure_invalid_response: The server sent an answer that Mannie could not read. Check that the API interface matches the server.
chat_failure_redirect_refused: The server answered with a redirect, which Mannie does not follow. Check the base URL.
chat_failure_credential_missing: The profile's API key is missing from the credential store. Enter it again in the provider settings.
chat_failure_credential_store_unavailabl: The credential store could not be read. Unlock it, then retry.
chat_failure_profile_missing: The provider profile of this reply no longer exists. Choose another profile, then retry.
chat_failure_no_profile: No provider profile exists. Add one in the provider settings.
chat_failure_internal: Mannie failed while writing this reply. Retry, and report the problem with the log file if it happens again.
chat_error_message_too_long: The message is longer than {maxBytes} bytes. Shorten it.
chat_error_title_too_long: The title is longer than {maxCharacters} characters.
chat_error_instructions_too_long: The instructions are longer than {maxBytes} bytes. Shorten them.
chat_error_run_active: A reply is being written in this conversation. Wait for it or stop it first.
chat_error_nothing_to_retry: The latest reply did not fail, stop or get interrupted, so there is nothing to retry.
chat_error_nothing_to_compact: There are not enough earlier messages to summarize yet.
chat_error_compacting: The conversation is being summarized. Try again when it is done.
chat_error_compaction_failed: The summary could not be written. {cause}
chat_error_profile_not_found: The provider profile no longer exists.
chat_error_written_by_newer_version: A newer version of Mannie wrote these settings, so this version does not change them.
chat_error_storage_failed: The conversation could not be read or saved. Restart Mannie, and report the problem with the log file if it happens again.
chat_error_shutting_down: Mannie is quitting and starts no more replies.
chat_instructions_section_description: Instructions that apply to every conversation, from its next reply on.
chat_providers_section_description: The servers and models that write the replies. API keys stay in the system's credential store.
chat_providers_empty_description: A profile names one model on one server, such as OpenAI or a local server.
chat_providers_dialog_description: Mannie checks the fields when you save, and keeps the API key in the system's credential store.
chat_providers_delete_description: "{name}" and its API key are deleted. Conversations that used it switch to the default profile.
chat_providers_field_interface_descripti: OpenAI's models use the Responses API. Most other servers use Chat Completions.
chat_providers_field_base_url_descriptio: The address that ends before /responses or /chat/completions.
chat_providers_defaults_applied: Mannie knows this model and filled in its limits.
chat_providers_field_credential_descript: Leave it empty if the server needs no key. Over plain HTTP, Mannie sends a key only to this computer or to a private network address.
chat_providers_field_credential_saved_de: Remove the key if the server needs none. Over plain HTTP, Mannie sends a key only to this computer or to a private network address.
chat_providers_credential_saved_placehol: A key is saved. Type a new key to replace it.
chat_providers_credential_remove_warning: Saving removes the saved key. The profile then sends no key.
chat_providers_field_effort_description: How much the model reasons before it answers. With the server's default, Mannie sends no effort setting.
chat_providers_limits_required: Enter the context window, at least {minContextWindow} tokens, and the output limit, at least {minOutputLimit} tokens.
chat_providers_error_invalid_name: Enter a name of up to 100 characters.
chat_providers_error_name_taken: Another profile already has this name.
chat_providers_error_invalid_base_url: Enter an http or https address without user name, query or fragment.
chat_providers_error_insecure_credential: Over plain HTTP, Mannie sends an API key only to this computer or to a private network address. Use https for this server, or remove the key.
chat_providers_error_invalid_model: Enter a model name of up to 200 characters.
chat_providers_error_invalid_limits: The context window must be between {minContextWindow} and {maxContextWindow} tokens, and leave at least {minBudget} tokens after the output limit.
chat_providers_error_invalid_credential: The API key is empty or too long, or it contains characters that a request cannot carry.
chat_providers_error_profile_in_use: A reply that is being written uses this profile. Delete it after the reply ends.
chat_providers_error_storage_failed: The profile could not be read or saved. Restart Mannie, and report the problem with the log file if it happens again.
chat_providers_store_no_secret_service: No credential store is running. On Linux, start GNOME Keyring or KWallet, then try again. Profiles without an API key still work.
chat_providers_store_unsupported_platfor: This system has no credential store that Mannie can use, so Mannie cannot save API keys. Profiles without a key still work.
chat_providers_store_access_denied: The credential store refused access. Unlock it, then try again.
chat_providers_store_other: The credential store failed. Try again, and report the problem with the log file if it happens again.
chat_providers_test_description: Mannie checks the API key, lists the server's models, and asks the model for a short reply.
chat_providers_note_model_not_listed: The server does not list this model. It may still answer, but check the model name.
chat_providers_note_model_list_unavailab: The server does not list its models, so the model name could not be checked.
chat_providers_note_no_usage_reported: The server reported no token counts. Mannie estimates the context instead, which is less exact.
chat_providers_note_no_reasoning_returne: The server accepted the reasoning effort but returned no reasoning.
chat_providers_skip_no_credential: Skipped because the profile has no API key.
chat_providers_skip_earlier_check_failed: Skipped because an earlier check failed.
chat_providers_skip_no_model_list: Skipped because the server lists no models.
chat_providers_skip_no_reasoning_effort: Skipped because the profile sets no reasoning effort.
chat_providers_test_reported_limits: The server reports a context window of {window} tokens and an output limit of {limit} tokens.
chat_providers_test_reported_window: The server reports a context window of {window} tokens.
chat_providers_test_limits_applied: The profile uses these limits now.
window_close_question_title: What should closing the window do?
window_close_question_description: In the system tray, Mannie keeps running and replies continue, and the tray icon opens the window again. Mannie remembers your choice, and you can change it in the settings.

match.countPlural=one: {count: number} reply is being written. Quitting interrupts it, and you can retry it after Mannie starts again.
match.countPlural=other: {count: number} replies are being written. Quitting interrupts them, and you can retry them after Mannie starts again.

window_quit_warning_title: Quit while replies are being written?
window_settings_description: What happens when you close Mannie's window.
window_settings_close_ask_description: Mannie asks once and remembers the answer.
window_settings_close_tray: Keep running in the system tray
window_settings_close_tray_description: Replies continue, and the tray icon opens the window again.
window_settings_close_quit_description: While replies are being written, Mannie asks first.
window_settings_load_failed_title: The window settings could not be read
window_error_invalid_label: A label of the tray menu is not valid.
window_error_request_not_pending: This question was already answered or withdrawn.
